benchmark_reference: 2025 final compliance report, AI for SMEs scoring guideline
summary: Under the one-to-four normalization of “up to four strong actions,” the score program has no branch for zero strong actions, five or more weak actions, and no counteraction.
details: An inclusive zero-to-four normalization removes this gap but overlaps the non-compliance branch for zero strong actions and two or fewer weak actions. Resolve the range and precedence through an explicit interpretation profile.
